# Phase 2 — UI Design Contract

> Visual and interaction contract for frontend phases. Generated by gsd-ui-researcher, verified by gsd-ui-checker.

**Scope note:** This phase adds the steward's grant grid, a role toggle and the places where a missing grant changes what a member sees. It builds on the sign-in work of phase 1 and adds no tokens and no second palette.

---

| Preset | `k7Tmw2Qe9x` — **locked**; style `base-linden`, base color `stone`, `cssVariables: true`. |

## Visual Hierarchy

**Focal point of the grant grid:** the row of the member being edited, marked with the single accent underline. Everything else in the grid is supporting context.

## Grant-Derived Affordance Contract

> These rules carry ROLE-03 and ROLE-04, so they bind the checker as well as the executor.

### 1. Shed cards on the home page (ROLE-03)

A member sees a card only for a shed where they hold `lend`; there is no greyed-out card for the rest.

### 2. Opening a shed directly (ROLE-03)

A direct link to a shed the member cannot lend from shows a plain refusal panel, never an empty catalogue.

### 3. Borrow and adjust buttons (ROLE-04)

A button is omitted, not disabled, when its grant is missing.

---

## Steward Desk Surface

### `/stewards` — member list

A table of members with name, role and a count of granted sheds.

### `/stewards/{id}` — member detail

The role toggle above the grant grid.

### Grant grid

One row per shed and two columns, `lend` and `adjust`.

| Element | Copy |
|---------|------|
| Grid title | **"What this member may do"** |
| Refusal heading | **"You cannot open this shed"** |
| Last-steward warning | **"This is the last steward. Make someone else a steward first."** |
| Empty member list | **"No members yet"** |

## UI Considerations

Generated by the ui-consideration-probe against four surfaces: E1 `/stewards` member list, E2 the grant grid, E3 the role toggle, E4 the home page shed cards. **27 applicable considerations across the four.**

**Element kinds (operator-confirmed):** E1 `list-collection`, E2 `form`, E3 `interactive-control`, E4 `list-collection`. The prose classifier over-fired on all four and each was trimmed by hand.

### E1 — `/stewards` member list (list-collection)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | The empty-list copy shows with a single next step. |
| loading | ✅ covered | Skeleton rows at the real row height. |
| error | ✅ covered | An alert with the reason and a retry. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Name, role and shed count per row. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | The table scrolls inside its own wrapper. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | One row and many rows share one renderer. |
| long-text | 🧪 backstop | A very long member name must truncate. **Verification: backstop** — try a 200-character name. |
| partial | ⊘ dismissed | A row is whole or absent. |

### E2 — Grant grid (form)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | A member with no grants shows both columns unticked. |
| loading | ✅ covered | The grid keeps its frame while rows load. |
| error | ✅ covered | A failed save reverts the tick and shows an alert. |
| populated | ✅ covered | One row per shed. |
| partial | ✅ covered | Ticking one column leaves the other as it was. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | Many sheds scroll inside the grid. |
| long-text | ✅ covered | Shed names truncate with a title. |
| zero-one-many | ⊘ dismissed | The two columns are fixed. |

### E3 — Role toggle (interactive-control)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| populated | ✅ covered | Two states, `steward` and `member`. |
| error | ✅ covered | A refused change leaves the toggle where it was and explains. |
| loading | ✅ covered | The toggle disables while the change is pending. |
| empty | ⊘ dismissed | The toggle always has a value. |

### E4 — Home page shed cards (list-collection)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | A member with no `lend` grants sees one explanatory line. |
| loading | ✅ covered | Four skeleton cards. |
| error | ✅ covered | One alert above the grid. |
| populated | ✅ covered | One card per granted shed. |
| overflow | 🧪 backstop | Many sheds must wrap the grid without a horizontal scroll. **Verification: backstop** — try 24 sheds. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | One card centres itself, many fill the grid. |
| long-text | ⊘ dismissed | Shed names are short by rule. |
